title: Flint Tools By Pixelization610
description: This Adds Flint tools, and I challenge you to try and play the game without punching trees or making wood tools. (Version 1.21.4)
body:
This mod adds flint tools to the game, using plant fibers to make them. These tools have low durability and are not efficient, so are normally not used. I challenge you to play the game without punching trees and not crafting wood tools. Have fun! (version 1.21.4 im hoping to update) 

                                                                                

                                                                                                          P.S. this is my first mod so pls dont judge
